source_text: Prima Numerorum lectio docuit quod exercitus Dei, qui exivit de terra Aegypti et iter egit per desertum, visitatus sit — numeratus per Moysen et Aaron. Forma praescripta: populus Dei egrediens de mundi Aegypto ad terram repromissionis — ad virtutum locum vel regni coelorum — ordinibus et meritorum gradibus incedat.
pass_a_gloss: First of-Numbers reading taught that army of-God, which went-out from land of-Egypt and journey made through desert, visited was — numbered through Moses and Aaron. Form prescribed: people of-God going-out from of-world Egypt to land of-promise — to of-virtues place or of-kingdom of-heavens — by-orders and of-merits grades let-it-advance.
pass_b_english: The first reading of Numbers taught that God’s army, which [[went out from Egypt and marched through the desert >> Bible:Numbers 1:1-3]], was “visited” — numbered through Moses and Aaron. The form is prescribed: God’s people leaving this world’s Egypt for the land of promise — toward the place of virtues or the glory of the kingdom — advance by ranks and grades of merit.
